title: Function tests: compare an expectation and notice a faulty copy
goal: Derive independent expectations, test valid and rejected paths, and demonstrate sensitivity to a specific error.

prerequisites.text: Complete BSL fundamentals: variables, types, conditions, and loops. Know how to preserve a separate source and run your training infobase.

sections.title: Why this task matters
paragraphs: A “tests passed” message compares nothing by itself. You need an independently calculated expectation, an actual value, and an action on mismatch. Check both the function and whether the test can fail on a known faulty copy.

Read the worked example and predict a changed input. The independent task uses a different contract. Save the previous training source before replacing a module; a personal Nexus mark is not an assessment of your explanation.

sections.title: A test asks a question with an observable answer
paragraphs: An “all good” message does not compare anything. ПроверитьРавно accepts the actual value, an independently calculated expectation and a case name. A mismatch raises an exception and prevents the success message. The case name identifies the broken agreement.

Calculate 600 for 30 minutes at 1200 per hour independently. Calling the same formula twice would allow the same error on both sides. Keep the business example separate from the implementation that must satisfy it.

sections.title: The complete worked example and its result
paragraphs: Three numeric assertions and a separate rejection assertion run before the four-check message. The expectations 600/0/1200 come from manual reasoning; another call to the same function does not establish a correct expectation.
Match code and result by each statement’s role. Explain matching output through inputs, execution order, and state; one observed run does not check every possible variant.

sections.title: A small table checks different rules
paragraphs: Three numeric cases cover an ordinary calculation, allowed zero and a full hour. They do not cover every input or rounding rule. A one-hour case alone cannot expose every unit or rounding error. Choose additional cases from the contract, such as one minute or a fractional rate.

For the negative input, the rejection flag begins false, becomes true only on an exception, and is asserted afterward. An exception anywhere in a large program is not equivalent to the intended rejection. This exercise deliberately isolates one invalid call; professional tests also identify the expected rejection reason.

sections.title: Trace the important transitions
paragraphs: A successful run concerns these inputs and this source only. A faulty test can print the same message. Keep a separate faulty copy, identify the first diverging case, and rerun after restoration without changing expectations.
Before the next statement, record state separately from messages already displayed. This finds the first divergence rather than guessing from the final line.

sections.title: Your prediction before revealing
paragraphs: Replace divisor 60 with 30. What should the first half-hour test do?
Write your answer before revealing it. Identify the changed input and unchanged rule, then compare with the changed example.

reveal.title: Check the prediction
paragraphs: Match the changed values with the same rule. This checks transfer rather than memorisation of the previous final line.

sections.title: Prove the test can fail
paragraphs: Preserve the working source. In a separate copy change division by 60 to division by 30. The source can still compile, but the first result becomes 1200 instead of 600. The “полчаса” case must stop execution and the final success message must not appear.

Restore the original formula and rerun the entire set. If the incorrect copy passes, verify the module and database update, assertion execution and success-message placement. Do not change the expected 600 to 1200 merely to obtain green output.

sections.title: A faulty variant and its first divergence
paragraphs: The faulty Остаток adds instead of subtracting. Emptying ПроверитьРавно makes it print the six-check success message anyway. This is an intentional false green, not a fix. The test must notice the faulty copy before the final message.
Keep the faulty variant separately. Restore the working version and repeat the positive case. Do not change an expectation merely because the program printed something else.

sections.title: State the scope of the evidence
paragraphs: This function neither reads database records nor depends on an open form or writes documents. Small isolated inputs can therefore test it. Rights, document persistence, UI and concurrent access require different scenarios in an appropriate environment.

Preserve the source, case table, successful result, incorrect copy and observed failure. A Nexus self-report stores the learner’s statement. Local execution alone is not server grading, proof of authorship or an official certificate.

sections.title: See the values and direction
paragraphs: The diagram unfolds the selected sequence. Labels do not replace code: match each transition to a statement and record what remains unchanged.

The diamond compares expected and actual values. A mismatch raises an exception before the final message. A match permits the next case; the complete set succeeds only after its last assertion. An empty assertion removes this decision itself.

flowchart.caption: Different paths have different outcomes
paths: The faulty Остаток adds instead of subtracting. Emptying ПроверитьРавно makes it print the six-check success message anyway. This is an intentional false green, not a fix. The test must notice the faulty copy before the final message.

Test another function, Остаток(Лимит, Занято). Independently expect70 for90/20,90 for90/0,0 for90/90, and0 for0/0. Separately require rejection of−1/0 and90/91: six checks. Replace subtraction with addition in a copy; the first case must fail. Restore the source and rerun all six without changing expectations.

sections.title: Now a different independent task
paragraphs: Test another function, Остаток(Лимит, Занято). Independently expect 70 for 90/20,90 for 90/0,0 for 90/90, and 0 for 0/0. Separately require rejection of−1/0 and 90/91: six checks. Replace subtraction with addition in a copy; the first case must fail. Restore the source and rerun all six without changing expectations.
The worked example is not a ready solution to this task. Use a separate starter; reveal the reference on request after your own attempt. Viewing it must not replace saved or unsaved work.

sections.title: How to check transfer
paragraphs: Run all six cases with numeric expectations independent of the implementation.
Label each control input, expected observation, and reason in advance. Use rejection where the contract requires it; do not turn an unknown result into a convenient zero.

sections.title: The exact work location in 1C
paragraphs: Three numeric assertions and a separate rejection assertion run before the four-check message. The expectations 600/0/1200 come from manual reasoning; another call to the same function does not establish a correct expectation.

In your separate training infobase, save the source, update the database configuration, and launch a new session from Designer. Distinguish the editor, saved configuration, and running version; an old session does not prove the new text ran.

paragraphs: The addition fault fails at«занята часть»; the faulty copy does not reach the final success message.

The source and expected messages accompany the explanation. Actual images of the complete worked example come from a separate training infobase; they are not your run or proof of your authorship. Record your independent work separately.

sections.title: What is established and what still needs explanation
paragraphs: The suite does not test the UI, permissions, concurrent writes, or all real-number values. The deliberate mutant checks sensitivity to one specific fault. Authorship and understanding remain separate from a green technical result.

Before marking completion, explain one changed input of your own. A technical pass, matching messages, and your completion mark are different facts; understanding is discussed through explanation and transfer.
